evidence_snippets: SecretManagerSecret "last-applied-configuration" error If you enable the direct reconciler for a SecretManagerSecret (using the alpha.cnrm.cloud.google.com/reconciler: direct annotation) in versions 1.131.0 through 1.133, reconciliation might fail with an API error: [kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration] must follow pattern [a-z0-9A-Z]+([ \.\-] [a-z0-9A-Z]+) ), be less than 64 characters, and must have a UTF encoding of less than 128 bytes This occurs because Config Connector incorrectly attempts to pass internal Kubernetes annotations as labels to the Secret Manager API.
